international_aviation.headline_en: SpiceJet to Lease 20 Aircraft to Expand Winter Operations to 200 Daily Flights
international_aviation.summary_en: SpiceJet finalized agreements to lease 20 aircraft for the winter schedule, targeting 200 daily flights.

sources.name: AeroTime — SpiceJet plans to nearly triple active fleet with deal for…
Aerospace Global News — SpiceJet lines up 20 leased aircraft as it rebuilds fleet f…

new_information: SpiceJet has finalized agreements with three aircraft operators to lease 20 aircraft under wet- and damp-lease arrangements.
The 20 leased aircraft comprise 15 Boeing and five Airbus aircraft, with deliveries scheduled in phases between mid-October and mid-November 2026.
SpiceJet's active operational fleet currently stands at 11 aircraft, and adding 20 leased jets will expand its operational fleet to about 31 aircraft.
SpiceJet aims to increase its operational schedule to approximately 200 flights per day during the upcoming winter season.
The leased Airbus aircraft will include the higher-capacity Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321).
SpiceJet Chief Business Officer Debojo Maharshi stated that the 20 aircraft will allow the carrier to strengthen its network, add frequencies, and offer more travel options.
